title: Exploring Diffusion Transformer Designs via Grafting

layout.note: A bento of five unequal panels: a narrow left column with (a) above (b), and a right block with (c) wide at the top, the narrow (e) beside it and (d) as a full-width strip beneath; every panel has a pale-blue title strip and the galleries sit edge to edge.

lesson: Make the teaser double as a roadmap: a left column for the method (a cost contrast using money-bag and coin icons, then the procedure with one operator glyph redrawn per phase) and sample galleries on the right, every panel a titled strip tied to a paper section in the caption.
